newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Astrakhan says plans $100 mln 1998 Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia Astrakhan says plans $100 mln 1998 Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's southern Astrakhan region will make a debut $100 million issue of Eurobond in 1998, a regional official said on Wednesday.
"We shall be working on the matter for the remaining half year and plan the issue for 1998," Nina Popova, deputy head of the region's Economy and Investment Policy Department, told a news conference.
She said the regional administration was working on the issue with the Finance Ministry, but did not have a lead manager as yet. She gave no more details.
Many Russian regions are now preparing Eurobond issues as they see international credit as cheaper than domestic loans.
